name: Washington
permitAge: 15 if enrolled in an approved driver training course; 15 and a half otherwise (DOL, RCW 46.20.055)

teen.nightLimit: Intermediate license: no driving 1 a.m. to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed driver 25 or older, or for school, religious or employment activities, or agricultural driving (RCW 46.20.075)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate license: first 6 months no passengers under 20 except immediate family; after that no more than 3 non-family passengers under 20 (RCW 46.20.075)
teen.phone: Permit and intermediate holders: no wireless device at all, hands-free included, except emergencies. All drivers: may not hold a phone even when stopped in traffic or at a light; single touch allowed (RCW 46.61.672).

notes: Knowledge test: 40 questions, 32 correct to pass; passing score valid 2 years; offered in 12 languages including Spanish (DOL).
Supervisor for permit holders: licensed at least 5 years, in the seat beside the driver (DOL, RCW 46.20.055).
License before 18 requires a driver training course. Intermediate license from 16.
DOL says night and passenger restrictions end after one year without a crash or traffic offense; not used in questions.
Move Over (RCW 46.61.212): move over one lane if possible or slow to at least 10 mph below the limit; zone 200 feet before and after. Fine amounts differ between sources; not used.
Left turn on red allowed from a one-way or two-way street onto a one-way street carrying traffic left, after stopping and yielding, unless a sign prohibits (RCW 46.61.055).
Under 21: zero tolerance for active THC as well (DOL DUI page).
